paragraphs: Rabbi Pinchas bar Chiyya the Kohen.
Mentioned in Tanchuma, Noach 5, but Hyman calls the name a scribal error and says it should read bar Chama, as the statement is cited there at 28.

notes.text: The frozen verb is כדמוכא, read contextually as “as the statement is cited.” The joined נחה is read as Noach5 and the later locator is28. The exact printed alignment remains a source question. Two named Tanchuma lookup requests did not resolve references in the source service, so no positive edition verification is claimed.

The consulted scan of Hyman, volume III, printed p. 1013, separates נח-ה and reads כדמובא (“as cited”); the frozen transcription’s joined נחה and כדמוכא remain unchanged in the Hebrew source. The scan also prints the later locator כ״ח (28). In the consulted Buber Tanchuma, Noach 5 names Rabbi Pinchas the Kohen bar Chiyya, whereas the corresponding teaching at Noach 18 names Rabbi Pinchas the Kohen bar Chama. This establishes the two named parallels, while leaving Hyman’s supplied 28 visible rather than silently replacing it with 18. Hyman’s assertion that the first patronymic is an error remains his own; the witnesses are not merged into an authority identity. The earlier lookup difficulties predate this named Buber comparison.
